annotations.title: YouTube earnings and watch hours calculator

description: Estimates YouTube ad earnings from monthly views and the RPM from YouTube Studio (or CPM, monetized playback % and the 55% long-form creator share), plus watch hours against the YouTube Partner Program threshold.

avg_view_duration_minutes.description: Optional average view duration in minutes, to work out watch hours.

cpm.description: Ad CPM, in currency units. Needs monetized_playback_pct.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

monetized_playback_pct.description: Share of views that show an ad, as a percentage.

monthly_views.description: Views per month on long-form videos.

rpm.description: Revenue per 1,000 views from YouTube Studio, in currency units. Use this or cpm.

name: youtube_earnings
title: YouTube earnings and watch hours calculator
